build_NetworkCIFAR: build a NetworkCIFAR model with a given genotype, channel count, layer depth, and class count
create_Cell: create a Cell module from a genotype with normal or reduction operations for NAS architecture search
run_drop_path: run drop_path regularization on a tensor with a specified dropout probability during training
create_AuxiliaryHeadCIFAR: create an AuxiliaryHeadCIFAR module for auxiliary classification on CIFAR-10 with a given channel count
review_Cell_forward: review the Cell forward method to understand how genotype-driven operations process input states
